id.description: Unique id; the builtin. prefix is reserved.

entry.description: Start file inside the plugin folder.

category.description: Menu path under Wtyczki; '/' makes a submenu.

requiresArgument.description: Opened for the file under the cursor (in the other panel).

accepts.description: The panel can receive files sent from a file panel with F5; the host asks it which receivers fit the selection.

provides.description: The panel can provide the selected rows as files for a file panel.

card.description: The plugin answers panel.card, so a dashboard tile with "card": "<plugin id>/<panel id>" shows this panel as a live widget.

extensions.description: An extension with the dot (".csv"), a file name ("package.json"), a pattern with * or ? ("*.openapi.json"), or "/" for folders.

priority.description: Highest wins; built-ins: markdown 50, images 40, folders 10, text 0. Folder views meant only for folders whose .c4k file names them use a negative value.

webRoot.description: Folder inside the plugin (relative, no ..) with the HTML/JS pages shown when preview.render returns kind "web". Required for that kind.

card.description: The plugin answers preview.card, so .c4k dashboards can show this preview as a live card.

enter.description: Enter on a matching file opens the pinned preview; Shift+Enter keeps the shell open.

setup.description: Folder previews: the plugin answers preview.setup, so when the user gives a folder this preview the app asks the plugin for the folder's options (the plugin asks the user) before writing the .c4k file.

suggest.description: When the cursor rests on a folder that matches this rule, the app offers this preview as the folder's view (accepting writes a .c4k file). Checked by the app on the folder listing; the plugin is asked (preview.suggest) only with ask: true and only after the rule matched.

minCount.description: At least this many matching files.

minShare.description: Matching files among all files of the folder (folders not counted).

contains.description: Entries (files or folders) that must all exist, e.g. ".obsidian".

message.description: Hint text per language code ("pl", "en"…); {count} = matching files. Default: the preview title.

ask.description: After the rule matched, ask the plugin with preview.suggest (it decides the score and message).

interval.description: How often the host calls the plugin in the background, e.g. "5m"; at least one minute. Needs the background permission.
